name: Special Inputs, Part 2 (Sayuri)
summary: Learn the Special motions Shiori doesn't have.
description: Learn the Special motions Shiori doesn't have.

pages.title: Different Input Sets
pages.text: Every character has their own set of inputs. Sayuri has {input:41236}, which Shiori doesn't. When you pick up a new character, check their command list first - the motions themselves always read the same way.

pages.title: Versions and Air Specials
pages.text: Not every Special has three versions: Sayuri's {input:214} gives the same move no matter which button you press. Some Specials also work in the air - her {input:236} moves have airborne versions.

pages.title: Rare Motions
pages.text: A few characters use rarer motions like {input:421} - their character guides list them. Don't sweat it: every motion reads the same way, directions left to right, attack button near the end.

tasks.label: Do {input:214A}, then {input:214B} - same move both times
tasks.prompt: Do 214A, let it finish, then do 214B - watch the exact same move come out twice.
